related-articles.looks: A row of three cards for related blogs or resources, picked automatically from the page's own tags, with up to three pinned first.
related-articles.use: Only at the end of blog or resource pages, when asked.

fields.heading: Pre-filled 'Related Blogs'.
fields.pinned1: Optional page to show first: a blog page on a blog, a resource page on a resource. The rest fill automatically.
